recent_reviews.name: Thanh
recent_reviews.text: Stephanie's place is huge and comfortable with great views. I enjoyed my stay there.

recent_reviews.name: Orsi
recent_reviews.text: We had a great time. The place to stay is huge and comfortable. The host is excellent; we were able to relax. The location is great, and the beach nearby is excellent!

recent_reviews.name: Danny
recent_reviews.text: Stephanie feels entitled to enter the place after she watches vigilantly from her home across the street to see if any house rules are not complied with - from hanging a towel on a chair to leaving the balcony door open. Money cannot buy happiness.
recent_reviews.host_response: Guest left balcony door open during a severe storm causing water damage; we entered only to close it and prevent further damage.

recent_reviews.name: Aurore
recent_reviews.text: Host entered in our absence, without asking or consent, to collect coin money for the air conditioning (not specified on the listing - borderline). She came while we were out or sleeping. She forgot the keys in the lock so we realised. Intolerable and prohibited by rental law.
recent_reviews.host_response: Entered due to a power failure to reset the AC coin meter; left the drawer key behind and the guest then took all the money inside.

recent_reviews.name: Tami
recent_reviews.text: Communicating with Stephanie was easy. Super spacious, typical Maltese, everything you need. Beds smell super good! Only negative: neighbours upstairs (likely an Airbnb too) were super noisy - kids running, loud voices.
recent_reviews.host_response: Apologised; informed the upstairs apartment as it was excessively loud.

recent_reviews.name: Sayem
recent_reviews.text: Amazing stay. Very clean apartment with everything I needed. Views from the balcony are epic. Stephanie is amazing, kind and friendly. Will 100% book again.

recent_reviews.name: Joost
recent_reviews.text: Good stay. Spacious, clean, beautiful view. Easy to find, everything present. Communication with Stephanie pleasant.

recent_reviews.name: Florencia
recent_reviews.text: Clean, spacious apartment matching the photos. Stephanie welcomed us in person despite our flight delay. Only downside: air conditioning is payable and was not specified in the listing. We used the fans and they were sufficient.

recent_reviews.name: Piotr
recent_reviews.text: Exactly as shown in the photos. Clean, with a beautiful balcony view. Excellent communication. Highly recommend.

recent_reviews.name: Nina
recent_reviews.text: Everything was perfect, the apartment was clean and affordable. Stephanie very kind and provided important information.

recent_reviews.name: Heike
recent_reviews.text: Beautiful apartment, well-equipped kitchen, plenty of space, west-facing balcony for breakfast/sunset. Great that it has 2 bathrooms. Bedrooms beautifully decorated, large and have air conditioning. Parking right next to the apartment.

recent_reviews.name: Charlotte
recent_reviews.text: Lovely stay (Flat 6). Amazing balcony view. Washing machine handy. Kitchen well equipped. Found the king bed mattress just a little too hard for my liking, but plenty of duvets/blankets. On the 'heights', peaceful. Great for fireworks.

positive: Great location near beach, shops, bus
negative_or_risk: COIN-OPERATED AC repeatedly flagged as 'not specified in the listing' (Aurore 1-star, Florencia 5-star) - a real friction/expectation-gap point even though the current L3 description now mentions it
HOST ENTERING THE UNIT without consent = the two 1-star reviews (Danny, Aurore); the only serious reputational issue on this listing
Noise from upstairs neighbours (Tami) - building is multi-let
King mattress 'too hard' (Charlotte) - minor, single mention
Stairs: Flat 5 is first-floor, 21 steps, no lift (per listing + photo); not complained about in reviews but a known access constraint
